judging: rtdb-residual-judge.mjs: per step, production's two rounds of a transport fix the strictness (ordered, or sorted where production itself delivered the same events in another order, or unsettled); here every step of every profile was ordered. Rows of the writer and of the observer connection are not compared with each other in order. A step that fireemu delivers in a different order between its own rounds would be needs-review. Fire time: WebSocket within 2 s; long polling within the production range plus or minus 5 s. Millisecond timings and transport counts are not compared.
